title: Treatise on the Standing Fog
summary: A treatise on raising a fog that stands where it is set and thickens round all who enter it.

title: The Dissolving Boundary Canon
summary: A canon on dissolving the line between the body and the mist until the user is neither inside nor outside.

title: The Twin Mist Treatise
summary: A treatise on two banks of mist that move as a pair and close on a foe from both sides.

title: Basin Fog and River Mist Canon
summary: A canon of fog that pools like water in a basin and mist that runs on like a river to carry the user away.

title: The Oath Beneath the Fog
summary: A canon of swearing an oath into the fog so that those who break faith inside it cannot find their way out.

title: Manual of the Unwalled Haze
summary: A manual of a haze with no edge that spreads as freely as the plateau wind and hides what moves in it.
